company.name: 99dresses
company.shortDescription: 99dresses is a virtual closet that allows users to trade fashion items with other users.
company.description:
99dresses allows users to trade the fashion items with other users.

The site started as a post-HSC  project for the founder, Nikki Durkin, in a collaboration between herself and Pollenizer, around December 2010, Pollenizer and 99dresses parted ways.

In November 2011, it was announced that 99dresses / Nikki would be participating in a YCombinator Program ([source](http://www.smh.com.au/technology/technology-news/aussie-nikki-joins-silicon-valley-millionaire-factory-20111118-1nlud.html)).
